otp_equivalent_factory_burned_fields.note: Which NVLink generation (1.0-4.0) and per-link bandwidth the silicon supports is fixed in hardware.
Links per device fixed by silicon: 4 (P100) / 6 (V100) / 12 (A100) / 18 (H100).
NRZ (Gen1-3) vs PAM4 (Gen4) fixed by the PHY generation.
Used by the NVSwitch fabric manager for routing/identity; surfaced via driver.

notes: NVLink does not define OTP/fuse content as a public protocol concept. Hardware-fixed attributes — NVLink generation, link count, NVHS modulation (NRZ vs PAM4), and PHY equalization defaults — are determined by the GPU/NVSwitch silicon and exposed to software through the NVIDIA driver / NVML, not through a published register/OTP map.
